WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), customer_shares AS (
  SELECT total_spent, total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS revenue_share
  FROM customer_totals
), above_average AS (
  SELECT total_spent, revenue_share
  FROM customer_shares
  WHERE revenue_share > (SELECT AVG(revenue_share) FROM customer_shares)
)
SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS average_amount_spent,
       AVG(revenue_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(revenue_share) - (SELECT AVG(revenue_share) FROM customer_shares) AS average_share_above_average
FROM above_average
